title: gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest shut down on 2026-12-01 (image edits)
summary: On 2026-12-01 OpenAI removes gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 (and its snapshot gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16) and chatgpt-image-latest from the API (announced 2026-06-02). This advisory covers image edit calls (POST /v1/images/edits, images.edit in the SDKs) that send one of these models; they fail from then on. openai-gpt-image-models-shutdown-2026-12-01 covers image generation. Calls that name these models inside the Responses API image_generation tool, or in Batch input files, are not matched.
migrationNote: Before 2026-12-01, change the model to gpt-image-2.6-sunburst or gpt-image-2.6-flare, the two replacements OpenAI's deprecations page names; it does not say which fits which old model, so SHAPI offers no automatic swap. Re-test the size, quality and output options you send, and switch any image_generation tool in the Responses API that names these models too.

provenance.quote: Shutdown date Model / system Recommended replacement Dec 1, 2026 gpt-image-1-mini gpt-image-2.6-sunburst or gpt-image-2.6-flare Dec 1, 2026 gpt-image-1.5 | gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16 gpt-image-2.6-sunburst or gpt-image-2.6-flare Dec 1, 2026 chatgpt-image-latest gpt-image-2.6-sunburst or gpt-image-2.6-flare
